Name: Maaseiah, Sealer of the Covenant
Summary: Maaseiah was among the chiefs who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's day, listed with Rehum and Hashabnah. NOTE ON IDENTITY: the text does not say whether this Maaseiah is the priest who stood by Ezra and sang at the wall's dedication, so this profile covers only the Nehemiah 10:25 sealer and does not merge him with any other Maaseiah.
LifeLesson: A sealed covenant is a promise put in writing.
